title: run_command
description: Run a command against the repository (e.g. tests, a build, a type-check, a read-only git query). Only a fixed allowlist of commands is actually permitted — roughly: `npm test`, `npm run <script>`, `npx tsc`, `pytest`, `python -m pytest`, `node <file>`, and read-only `git status`/`git diff`/`git log`. Anything else is rejected before it runs. Requires user confirmation unless the harness is running with --yolo/--auto. Runs with no shell (so no `;`, `&&`, `|`, or redirection), a restricted environment, and a timeout.

command.description: The program to run, e.g. "npm", "pytest", "node", "git". Not a shell command line — do not include arguments here.

args.description: Arguments to pass to the program, as separate tokens (e.g. ["run", "build"]), not one combined string.

cwd.description: Directory to run the command in, relative to the repository root. Defaults to the repository root.
